What a company needs to see.

Approval

Every consequential step runs under a policy you can read. Money actions, an invoice or a contract, always wait for a person.

Record

Every step lands on a hash-chained record: who asked, who approved, what it cost.

Budget

Budgets slow the assistant down before they stop it.

Separation

Each company workspace is separate. No workspace reads another's data.

Residency

Planned on the Business plan: choose the region your data is kept in, for 10 % more. Until it ships, ask us.

Security and trust

What is true now is on our security page: approvals, the record, budgets, separation and masking. Not yet: SOC 2 or ISO certification. Our data processing agreement, on the European Commission's standard clauses, is published at massrelay.ai/dpa.
